1	"""grokking_optimizers/parallel/distributed_step.py — the rank-aware
2	DECOMPOSED train step (design §6.2 ``fused_train_step_distributed``).
3	
4	IMPLEMENTS /workspace/.parallelism_design.md §6.2 (task #25 phase-2, Lane C) as
5	a NEW module wrapping the existing ``dispatch.fused_train_step`` — the §2.1
6	decomposition, cut at the B2 seam:
7	
8	    [1] production fused step on THIS rank's batch shard  → local grad[total]
9	    [2] FIXED-ORDER cross-DP grad reduce (all_gather + ascending-rank fp32 sum
10	        — the §2.7/§6.4 A/A/A non-negotiable; never a raw NCCL reduce-scatter)
11	    [3] sharded-optimizer apply over the OWNED flat slice   (§2.3)
12	    [4] all-gather params → full updated params on every rank (§2.1[4])
13	
14	HARDWARE LINEAGE: steps [1]-[4] are byte-for-byte the sequence
15	tests/hw/test_dp2_loopback_determinism.py proved green on 1×H100 (ef433ac,
16	DP=2 loopback cross-rank A/A/A); this module PROMOTES that proven worker logic
17	into a production-shaped, importable entry so the 8× driver and the tests call
18	ONE implementation. The DP=2 worker path here is re-gated by
19	tests/hw/test_distributed_step.py before the window.
20	
21	DEPENDENCY-INJECTED SHARDED APPLY: the post-reduce-scatter optimizer kernel is
22	passed in as ``sharded_apply`` (signature below). The 1-GPU gates inject the
23	JIT ``sharded_optimizer_binding.sharded_opt_step`` (bit-parity-proven,
24	DELIVERABLE 1); the future production build injects the _ops entry once the
25	kernel lands in dispatch (csrc/bindings is another lane's surface — this
26	module deliberately does not import it).
27	
28	KERNEL-CUT NOTE (§2.2, honest scope): the fused kernel currently always runs
29	its in-kernel P3 (the ``if constexpr (Par::kShardOptGrad) return;`` early-exit
30	is dispatch-wiring work on csrc/bindings — out of this lane's surface). Under
31	ZeRO>=2 this module therefore captures the grad via ``return_grad=True``,
32	RESETS the params the in-kernel P3 advanced, and applies the sharded kernel on
33	the reduce-scattered grad — numerically the §2.1 dance with a redundant P3
34	whose result is discarded (correctness-identical, bit-gated; the wasted P3 is
35	a measured inefficiency the §2.2 early-exit removes at the 8× window, never a
36	correctness risk). The world=1 default short-circuits to the plain fused step
37	(zero overhead on the single-GPU path).
38	
39	Scalars: the per-step optimizer scalars come from ``_opt_scalars_from`` — the
40	SINGLE source the production path uses (bit-parity depends on it).
41	"""
42	
43	from __future__ import annotations
44	
45	import dataclasses
46	from typing import Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple
47	
48	from grokking_optimizers.parallel.shard_map import even_partition
49	from grokking_optimizers.parallel.zero3 import FlatShardPlan, Zero3FlatParamStore
50	
51	# OptId mirror (opt_components.cuh) for the ELEMENTWISE ids this step's flat
52	# sharded apply supports today (the per-tensor cells need the tensor-granular
53	# full-kernel path, design §2.3 — loudly rejected below, not silently wrong).
54	_ELEMENTWISE_OPTID: Dict[str, int] = {"adamw": 0, "lion": 1, "grokfast": 2}
55	
56	# sharded_apply(opt_id, params_shard, grad_shard, state_shard, sc: dict, step)
57	ShardedApply = Callable[..., None]
58	
59	
60	def _torch():
61	    import torch  # noqa: PLC0415
62	    return torch
63	
64	
65	@dataclasses.dataclass
66	class DistStepContext:
67	    """Everything rank-shaped the decomposed step needs.
68	
69	    world/rank      : DP group coordinates (world=1 ⇒ degenerate single-GPU).
70	    plan/store/state: the rank's ZeRO-3 flat plan + resident param-shard store
71	                      + shard-local [m|v|extra] state planes ([3, shard_numel]).
72	    process_group   : torch.distributed group for the collectives (None ⇒ the
73	                      default group). Ignored at world=1.
74	    """
75	
76	    world: int
77	    rank: int
78	    plan: FlatShardPlan
79	    store: Zero3FlatParamStore
80	    state: "object"               # torch.Tensor [3, shard_numel]
81	    process_group: Optional[object] = None
82	
83	
84	def make_dist_step_context(named_sizes: Sequence[Tuple[str, int]], world: int,
85	                           rank: int, opt_name: str, full_flat,
86	                           process_group=None) -> DistStepContext:
87	    """Build the rank's context from the model's named sizes + initial flat
88	    params (every rank passes the SAME full_flat — same-seed init, the §7.1
89	    convention). Elementwise opts only (loud otherwise, §2.3)."""
90	    torch = _torch()
91	    if opt_name not in _ELEMENTWISE_OPTID:
92	        raise ValueError(
93	            f"distributed_step: {opt_name!r} is not an elementwise OptId "
94	            f"{sorted(_ELEMENTWISE_OPTID)} — the per-tensor cells "
95	            f"(muon/SG11/SG15/SG2) need the tensor-granular full-kernel path "
96	            f"(design §2.3), which is not this flat apply.")
97	    from grokking_optimizers.parallel.zero3 import flat_plan_for_optimizer
98	    plan = flat_plan_for_optimizer(named_sizes, world, opt_name)
99	    store = Zero3FlatParamStore(plan, rank, full_flat=full_flat)
100	    state = torch.zeros(3, store.shard.numel(), device=full_flat.device,
101	                        dtype=torch.float32)
102	    return DistStepContext(world=world, rank=rank, plan=plan, store=store,
103	                           state=state, process_group=process_group)
104	
105	
106	def shard_batch_rows(tokens, targets, world: int, rank: int):
107	    """Deterministic row shard of a fixed batch, 16-aligned per rank (the
108	    proven _shard_batch from the DP=2 loopback gate — wgmma needs B%16==0 and
109	    pre-rounding to 16*world keeps the shards balanced + comparable)."""
110	    B = int(targets.shape[0])
111	    step = 16 * max(1, world)
112	    Bw = B - (B % step)
113	    s, e = even_partition(Bw, max(1, world), rank)
114	    return tokens[s:e].contiguous(), targets[s:e].contiguous(), Bw
115	
116	
117	def fixed_order_allreduce_grad(grad, world: int, group=None):
118	    """THE §2.7/§6.4 fixed-order cross-rank grad reduce: NCCL all_gather (pure
119	    data movement — bit-exact, order-free) then an ASCENDING-RANK fp32 sum,
120	    averaged by world. Identical on every rank and across reruns. world=1 ⇒
121	    returns grad unchanged (already the full reduced grad)."""
122	    if world <= 1:
123	        return grad
124	    torch = _torch()
125	    import torch.distributed as dist  # noqa: PLC0415
126	    total = grad.numel()
127	    gathered = torch.empty(total * world, dtype=grad.dtype, device=grad.device)
128	    torch.cuda.synchronize()      # the megakernel fully done before the collective
129	    dist.all_gather_into_tensor(gathered, grad.contiguous(), group=group)
130	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
131	    acc = torch.zeros(total, dtype=torch.float32, device=grad.device)
132	    for r in range(world):        # ascending rank — fixed, structural order
133	        acc += gathered[r * total:(r + 1) * total]
134	    acc /= float(world)
135	    return acc
136	
137	
138	def allgather_full_params(ctx: DistStepContext):
139	    """§2.1[4]: reconstitute the full updated params on every rank. world=1 /
140	    in-process virtual ranks use the store's gather; a launched job uses the
141	    padded all_gather convention inside Zero3FlatParamStore.gather_full."""
142	    if ctx.world <= 1:
143	        return ctx.store.gather_full()
144	    return ctx.store.gather_full(group=ctx.process_group)
145	
146	
147	def fused_train_step_distributed(
148	        model_name: str, opt_name: str, model, optimizer, tokens, targets, *,
149	        ctx: DistStepContext, sharded_apply: ShardedApply, state_cache: dict,
150	        step: int, gemm_impl: str = "wgmma",
151	        decompose_at_world1: bool = False):
152	    """ONE decomposed rank-aware step (design §6.2 [1]-[7]). Returns
153	    (loss_local, full_params_after) — full params are also scattered back into
154	    ``model`` (the existing fused_train_step contract keeps model/state_cache
155	    coherent for step+1).
156	
157	    world=1 + decompose_at_world1=False (the production default) is the PLAIN
158	    fused step — literally unchanged single-GPU behavior (§6.2: "the
159	    single-GPU path is literally unchanged"). decompose_at_world1=True forces
160	    the full decomposition at world=1 — the §7.1 identity gate's mode (must be
161	    BIT-IDENTICAL to the plain path; gated by tests/hw/test_distributed_step.py).
162	    """
163	    torch = _torch()
164	    from grokking_optimizers.dispatch import fused_train_step, _opt_scalars_from
165	    if opt_name not in _ELEMENTWISE_OPTID:
166	        raise ValueError(f"elementwise OptIds only (got {opt_name!r}) — see §2.3")
167	
168	    if ctx.world <= 1 and not decompose_at_world1:
169	        loss = fused_train_step(model_name, opt_name, model, optimizer,
170	                                tokens, targets, state_cache=state_cache,
171	                                step=step, gemm_impl=gemm_impl)
172	        named = [(n, p) for n, p in model.named_parameters() if p.requires_grad]
173	        total = sum(p.numel() for _, p in named)
174	        full = torch.empty(total, device=next(model.parameters()).device)
175	        off = 0
176	        for _, p in named:
177	            n = p.numel()
178	            full[off:off + n].copy_(p.data.reshape(-1))
179	            off += n
180	        return loss, full
181	
182	    named = [(n, p) for n, p in model.named_parameters() if p.requires_grad]
183	    total = sum(p.numel() for _, p in named)
184	    dev = next(model.parameters()).device
185	    if total != ctx.plan.total:
186	        raise ValueError(f"plan total {ctx.plan.total} != model total {total}")
187	
188	    # [0] (ZeRO-3) full pre-gather of params → the model the kernel will run.
189	    #     The store is authoritative between steps; scatter into p.data so the
190	    #     fused step launches on the gathered values (§3.2(a)).
191	    full_before = allgather_full_params(ctx)
192	    off = 0
193	    for _, p in named:
194	        n = p.numel()
195	        p.data.reshape(-1).copy_(full_before[off:off + n])
196	        off += n
197	
198	    # [1] the fused step on THIS rank's batch shard → local grad. (The in-kernel
199	    #     P3 also runs and advances p.data — discarded below; see the module
200	    #     docstring's §2.2 note.)
201	    tok_sh, tgt_sh, _bw = shard_batch_rows(tokens, targets, ctx.world, ctx.rank)
202	    loss, grad_local = fused_train_step(model_name, opt_name, model, optimizer,
203	                                        tok_sh, tgt_sh, state_cache=state_cache,
204	                                        step=step, return_grad=True,
205	                                        gemm_impl=gemm_impl)
206	
207	    # [2] fixed-order cross-DP grad reduce (identity at world=1).
208	    grad_full = fixed_order_allreduce_grad(grad_local, ctx.world,
209	                                           group=ctx.process_group)
210	
211	    # [3] sharded apply over the OWNED slices (in place on the store's shard +
212	    #     the rank's [m|v|extra] planes), with the production scalars.
213	    sc = _opt_scalars_from(optimizer, step)
214	    opt_id = _ELEMENTWISE_OPTID[opt_name]
215	    for fs, fe, ss, se in ctx.store.owned():
216	        params_shard = ctx.store.shard[ss:se].contiguous()
217	        grad_shard = grad_full[fs:fe].contiguous()
218	        state_shard = ctx.state[:, ss:se].reshape(-1).contiguous()
219	        sharded_apply(opt_id, params_shard, grad_shard, state_shard,
220	                      sc["lr"], sc["beta1"], sc["beta2"], sc["eps"],
221	                      sc["weight_decay"], sc["bc1"], sc["bc2"],
222	                      sc.get("alpha", 0.98), sc.get("lamb", 2.0), step)
223	        ctx.store.shard[ss:se].copy_(params_shard)
224	        ctx.state[:, ss:se].copy_(state_shard.view(3, se - ss))
225	
226	    # INVARIANT: the sharded apply above started from params-BEFORE-the-step —
227	    # the store was gathered before [1] and is never touched by the kernel
228	    # (the in-kernel P3 mutates p.data only, and that result is discarded by
229	    # the [4]/[5] overwrite below). This is what makes the decomposed update
230	    # bit-identical to a clean B2-cut kernel (the §2.2 early-exit, once wired).
231	
232	    # [4] all-gather the updated shards → full params; [5] scatter into p.data
233	    #     so model/state_cache stay coherent for step+1.
234	    full_after = allgather_full_params(ctx)
235	    off = 0

239	        off += n

1	"""grokking_optimizers/parallel/zero3.py — ZeRO-3 PARAM partitioning,
2	gather/release around the fused step, and the sharded optimizer-state
3	checkpoint/resume round-trip.
4	
5	IMPLEMENTS /workspace/.parallelism_design.md §3 (task #25 phase-2, Lane C):
6	  * §3.2 option (a) FULL PRE-GATHER — the locked first ZeRO-3 increment: the
7	    full flat param blob is reconstituted transiently for the megakernel
8	    launch (the kernel reads full params through P1) and RELEASED after the
9	    step; only the rank's shard stays resident between steps. Options (b)
10	    per-phase gather (rejected — P1 is barrier-free across layers) and (c)
11	    in-kernel NVSHMEM gather (frontier, only if (a) OOMs at the flagship
12	    size) are documented decisions, not built here.
13	  * §3.4 the shard partition respects the per-TENSOR optimizer constraint via
14	    grokking_optimizers.parallel.shard_map (elementwise-even for elementwise
15	    optimizers; tensor-granular for muon/SG11/SG15/SG2) — this module turns
16	    those plans into FLAT-BLOB slices (the megakernel ABI is the flat
17	    ``float[total]`` blob + the generated offset tables, design §0.2; the
18	    existing per-tensor ``ZeRO3Sharder`` shards framework params, NOT the
19	    kernel blob — that is the gap this module fills).
20	  * checkpoint/save-resume: each rank persists ONLY its param shard + opt-state
21	    shard (+ a loud plan fingerprint); resume must be BIT-EXACT (gated by
22	    tests/hw/test_zero3_roundtrip.py, building on the ef433ac sharded-opt
23	    bit-parity).
24	
25	DESIGN NOTES:
26	  * The flat state layout is the kernel's: ``[m | v | extra]`` parallel to the
27	    flat param blob (design §0.2) — a rank's state shard is the SAME slices of
28	    each of the 3 (or more) state planes, kept shard-local exactly the way the
29	    sharded_optimizer_kernel binding consumes them ([m_sh | v_sh | extra_sh]).
30	  * world=1 degenerates to no-op copies (the §7.1 identity). The multi-rank
31	    collective path reuses the padded all_gather_into_tensor convention of
32	    ``ZeRO3Sharder.all_gather_params`` (one source of conventions); when
33	    torch.distributed is not initialized, gather_full falls back to the
34	    VIRTUAL-rank path (peer stores in-process) — the honest 1-GPU loopback,
35	    used by the round-trip test. There is no silent wrong-world fallback:
36	    mismatches raise.
37	
38	Import-safe without torch at module import; torch is required at call time
39	for tensor ops (guarded with a loud error).
40	"""
41	
42	from __future__ import annotations
43	
44	import dataclasses
45	import hashlib
46	import json
47	from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple
48	
49	from grokking_optimizers.parallel.shard_map import (
50	    ShardPlan,
51	    partition_elementwise_even,
52	    partition_tensor_granular,
53	    shard_mode_for_optimizer,
54	)
55	
56	
57	def _torch():
58	    try:
59	        import torch  # noqa: PLC0415
60	        return torch
61	    except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover
62	        raise RuntimeError("zero3 tensor ops require torch") from e
63	
64	
65	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
66	#  Flat-blob slice plan (the megakernel-ABI view of a ShardPlan).
67	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
68	
69	
70	@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
71	class FlatShardPlan:
72	    """Per-rank contiguous slices of the FLAT param blob [0, total).
73	
74	    ``slices[r]`` = ordered list of (start, end) in flat-blob coordinates;
75	    within a rank the slices are ascending and non-overlapping; across ranks
76	    they partition [0, total) exactly. ``mode``/``world`` echo the shard_map
77	    plan. The fingerprint pins (mode, world, total, every boundary) so a
78	    checkpoint can refuse a mismatched resume LOUDLY.
79	    """
80	
81	    mode: str
82	    world: int
83	    total: int
84	    slices: List[List[Tuple[int, int]]]
85	
86	    def rank_numel(self, rank: int) -> int:
87	        return sum(e - s for s, e in self.slices[rank])
88	
89	    def fingerprint(self) -> str:
90	        payload = json.dumps(
91	            {"mode": self.mode, "world": self.world, "total": self.total,
92	             "slices": self.slices},
93	            sort_keys=True).encode()
94	        return hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
95	
96	
97	def flat_plan_for_optimizer(named_sizes: Sequence[Tuple[str, int]], world: int,
98	                            opt) -> FlatShardPlan:
99	    """Build the FLAT-blob plan for an optimizer (§3.4 mode keying).
100	
101	    ELEMENTWISE → one contiguous even slice of the WHOLE flat blob per rank
102	    (the partition the DP=2 loopback gate already validated — even_partition
103	    over [0,total)). PER-TENSOR → whole tensors per rank (tensor-granular LPT),
104	    mapped to flat coordinates via the named_sizes prefix sum (the same
105	    named_parameters() order the generated layout headers encode).
106	    """
107	    mode = shard_mode_for_optimizer(opt)
108	    total = sum(int(n) for _, n in named_sizes)
109	    world = max(1, int(world))
110	    offsets: Dict[str, int] = {}
111	    off = 0
112	    for name, n in named_sizes:
113	        offsets[name] = off
114	        off += int(n)
115	
116	    slices: List[List[Tuple[int, int]]]
117	    if mode == "tensor_granular":
118	        plan: ShardPlan = partition_tensor_granular(named_sizes, world)
119	        slices = []
120	        for r in range(world):
121	            sl = [(offsets[name] + s, offsets[name] + e)
122	                  for name, s, e in plan.slices[r]]
123	            slices.append(sorted(sl))
124	    else:
125	        # Elementwise: ONE contiguous slice of the flat blob per rank — the
126	        # convention the sharded-opt kernel + DP loopback tests use
127	        # (even_partition over [0,total), NOT per-tensor slicing).
128	        from grokking_optimizers.parallel.shard_map import even_partition
129	        slices = []
130	        for r in range(world):
131	            s, e = even_partition(total, world, r)
132	            slices.append([(s, e)] if e > s else [])
133	    return FlatShardPlan(mode=mode, world=world, total=total, slices=slices)
134	
135	
136	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
137	#  Param store: resident shard + gather/release around the fused step (§3.2a).
138	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
139	
140	
141	class Zero3FlatParamStore:
142	    """One rank's resident param shard + the full-pre-gather/release dance.
143	
144	    Lifecycle per step (design §2.1 with §3.2(a)):
145	        full = store.gather_full(...)        # [0] reconstitute for the kernel
146	        <fused megakernel step on full>      # [1] (+ ZeRO>=2 grad dance)
147	        <sharded-opt updates store.shard>    # [3] via shard_view()
148	        store.release(full)                  # keep only the shard resident
149	    ``gather_full`` sources non-owned slices from (in priority order):
150	      * ``peers``      — other ranks' stores IN-PROCESS (the 1-GPU virtual-rank
151	                         loopback; honest: real data movement, just one device);
152	      * torch.distributed all-gather on ``group`` when a job is launched;
153	      * world==1       — the degenerate copy.
154	    Anything else raises (no silent stale-params path).
155	    """
156	
157	    def __init__(self, plan: FlatShardPlan, rank: int, full_flat=None,
158	                 device=None, dtype=None) -> None:
159	        torch = _torch()
160	        if not (0 <= rank < plan.world):
161	            raise ValueError(f"rank {rank} out of range for world {plan.world}")
162	        self.plan = plan
163	        self.rank = rank
164	        n = plan.rank_numel(rank)
165	        if full_flat is not None:
166	            if full_flat.numel() != plan.total:
167	                raise ValueError(
168	                    f"full_flat numel {full_flat.numel()} != plan total {plan.total}")
169	            parts = [full_flat[s:e] for s, e in plan.slices[rank]]
170	            self.shard = (torch.cat(parts).clone() if parts else
171	                          full_flat.new_empty(0))
172	        else:
173	            self.shard = torch.zeros(
174	                n, device=device, dtype=dtype if dtype is not None else torch.float32)
175	
176	    # Owned-slice iteration: (flat_start, flat_end, shard_start, shard_end).
177	    def owned(self) -> List[Tuple[int, int, int, int]]:
178	        out = []
179	        o = 0
180	        for s, e in self.plan.slices[self.rank]:
181	            out.append((s, e, o, o + (e - s)))
182	            o += e - s
183	        return out
184	
185	    def shard_view(self):
186	        """The mutable resident shard (the sharded-opt kernel's params_shard)."""
187	        return self.shard
188	
189	    def gather_full(self, peers: Optional[Sequence["Zero3FlatParamStore"]] = None,
190	                    group=None, out=None):
191	        torch = _torch()
192	        full = out if out is not None else torch.empty(
193	            self.plan.total, device=self.shard.device, dtype=self.shard.dtype)
194	        if full.numel() != self.plan.total:
195	            raise ValueError("gather_full: out has wrong numel")
196	        # own slices first (always local).
197	        for fs, fe, ss, se in self.owned():
198	            full[fs:fe].copy_(self.shard[ss:se])
199	        if self.plan.world == 1:
200	            return full
201	        if peers is not None:
202	            stores = {p.rank: p for p in peers}
203	            stores[self.rank] = self
204	            if sorted(stores) != list(range(self.plan.world)):
205	                raise ValueError(
206	                    f"gather_full(peers): need every rank exactly once, got {sorted(stores)}")
207	            for r, st in stores.items():
208	                if r == self.rank:
209	                    continue
210	                if st.plan.fingerprint() != self.plan.fingerprint():
211	                    raise ValueError("gather_full(peers): plan fingerprint mismatch")
212	                for fs, fe, ss, se in st.owned():
213	                    full[fs:fe].copy_(st.shard[ss:se])
214	            return full
215	        # Real collective path (8× window): padded all_gather_into_tensor over
216	        # the CONTIGUOUS elementwise slices (one slice/rank). Tensor-granular
217	        # gathers go per-slice (lumpier; bounded by 30 tensors).
218	        import torch.distributed as dist  # noqa: PLC0415
219	        if not (dist.is_available() and dist.is_initialized()):
220	            raise RuntimeError(
221	                "gather_full: world>1 but neither peers given nor "
222	                "torch.distributed initialized — refusing a stale gather")
223	        if self.plan.mode == "elementwise_even":
224	            per = (self.plan.total + self.plan.world - 1) // self.plan.world
225	            buf = self.shard.new_zeros(per)
226	            buf[: self.shard.numel()].copy_(self.shard)
227	            gathered = self.shard.new_empty(per * self.plan.world)
228	            dist.all_gather_into_tensor(gathered, buf, group=group)
229	            for r in range(self.plan.world):
230	                s = min(r * per, self.plan.total)
231	                e = min(s + per, self.plan.total)
232	                if e > s:
233	                    full[s:e].copy_(gathered[r * per:r * per + (e - s)])
234	        else:
235	            # tensor-granular: broadcast each rank's slice list from its owner.
236	            for r in range(self.plan.world):
237	                for (s, e) in self.plan.slices[r]:
238	                    seg = full[s:e]
239	                    if r == self.rank:
240	                        # already copied from our shard above
241	                        pass
242	                    dist.broadcast(seg, src=r, group=group)
243	        return full
244	
245	    def release(self, full) -> None:
246	        """End-of-step: pull the owned slices back into the resident shard.
247	        The caller drops ``full`` afterwards (the §3.2(a) transient buffer)."""
248	        if full.numel() != self.plan.total:
249	            raise ValueError("release: full has wrong numel")
250	        for fs, fe, ss, se in self.owned():
251	            self.shard[ss:se].copy_(full[fs:fe])
252	
253	
254	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
255	#  Sharded optimizer-state checkpoint (bit-exact save/resume).
256	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
257	
258	_CKPT_VERSION = 1
259	
260	
261	def save_sharded_checkpoint(path: str, *, plan: FlatShardPlan, rank: int,
262	                            step: int, param_shard, opt_state_shard,
263	                            extra_meta: Optional[Dict] = None) -> None:
264	    """Persist ONE rank's shard-local step state (ZeRO-3: each rank saves only
265	    its 1/N — the aggregate IS the checkpoint).
266	
267	    param_shard     : [shard_numel] fp32 (the resident Zero3FlatParamStore shard)
268	    opt_state_shard : [k * shard_numel] fp32, the kernel's shard-local
269	                      [m | v | extra] planes exactly as sharded_opt_step uses
270	                      them (k = planes; 3 for the elementwise cells).
271	    The plan fingerprint + (world, rank, mode, step) are stored and VALIDATED
272	    on load — resuming under a different partition is a hard error, never a
273	    silent re-shard.
274	    """
275	    torch = _torch()
276	    n = plan.rank_numel(rank)
277	    if param_shard.numel() != n:
278	        raise ValueError(f"param_shard numel {param_shard.numel()} != plan shard {n}")
279	    if opt_state_shard.numel() % max(n, 1) != 0:
280	        raise ValueError(
281	            f"opt_state_shard numel {opt_state_shard.numel()} is not a whole "
282	            f"multiple of shard_numel {n} — the [m|v|extra] planes are misaligned")
283	    obj = {
284	        "version": _CKPT_VERSION,
285	        "fingerprint": plan.fingerprint(),
286	        "mode": plan.mode,
287	        "world": plan.world,
288	        "rank": rank,
289	        "total": plan.total,
290	        "step": int(step),
291	        "param_shard": param_shard.detach().cpu().clone(),
292	        "opt_state_shard": opt_state_shard.detach().cpu().clone(),
293	        "extra_meta": dict(extra_meta or {}),
294	    }
295	    torch.save(obj, path)
296	
297	
298	def load_sharded_checkpoint(path: str, *, plan: FlatShardPlan, rank: int) -> Dict:
299	    """Load + LOUDLY validate one rank's shard checkpoint against the live plan.
300	
301	    Returns the dict with 'param_shard'/'opt_state_shard' still on CPU (the
302	    caller .to(device)'s them); raises on ANY fingerprint/world/rank/total
303	    mismatch (design discipline: deterministic shard boundaries are part of
304	    the cross-rank A/A/A contract — a drifted plan must never load).
305	    """
306	    torch = _torch()
307	    obj = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
308	    if obj.get("version") != _CKPT_VERSION:
309	        raise RuntimeError(f"checkpoint version {obj.get('version')} != {_CKPT_VERSION}")
310	    if obj["fingerprint"] != plan.fingerprint():
311	        raise RuntimeError(
312	            "sharded checkpoint plan fingerprint mismatch — the partition "
313	            f"(mode/world/boundaries) changed since save (saved mode={obj['mode']} "
314	            f"world={obj['world']}, live mode={plan.mode} world={plan.world}). "
315	            "Refusing to resume; re-shard explicitly if intended.")
316	    if obj["rank"] != rank:
317	        raise RuntimeError(
318	            f"checkpoint is rank {obj['rank']}'s shard, asked to load as rank {rank}")
319	    n = plan.rank_numel(rank)
320	    if obj["param_shard"].numel() != n:
321	        raise RuntimeError("checkpoint param_shard numel != plan shard numel")
322	    return obj
323	
324	
325	__all__ = [
326	    "FlatShardPlan",
327	    "flat_plan_for_optimizer",
328	    "Zero3FlatParamStore",
329	    "save_sharded_checkpoint",

331	]

1	"""grokking_optimizers/parallel/shard_map.py — the ZeRO shard PARTITION.
2	
3	IMPLEMENTS /workspace/.parallelism_design.md §3.4 (the shard partition that
4	respects the per-TENSOR optimizer constraint) + the elementwise even-partition
5	helper (design §2.4 "shard the flat [0,total) by even-partition").
6	
7	THE PROBLEM (design §3.4): ``ZeRO3Sharder._even_partition`` splits the FLAT param
8	buffer mid-tensor. That breaks muon / SuperGrok11 / SuperGrok15 / SuperGrok2 —
9	their P2.x optimizer stages (Newton–Schulz over a whole 2D weight; the per-tensor
10	meta-net mu/gate; SG2's segmented sort + CSA/HCA/PEER/GRU) need the WHOLE
11	matrix/tensor on ONE rank (design §0.4/§2.4). So the ZeRO-3 shard for those cells
12	must be TENSOR-GRANULAR, not element-granular.
13	
14	THIS MODULE (pure functions on SIZE LISTS — no torch, no torch.distributed, no
15	GPU, so it is CPU/CI-testable per design §7):
16	
17	  * :func:`even_partition`            — the flat element partition (mirrors
18	                                        ``distributed._even_partition`` exactly).
19	  * :func:`partition_elementwise_even`— per-rank flat slices for the ELEMENTWISE
20	                                        optimizers (finer, best balance).
21	  * :func:`partition_tensor_granular` — assign WHOLE tensors to ranks (greedy by
22	                                        numel, balanced) so NO tensor is split —
23	                                        REQUIRED for muon/SG11/SG15/SG2 (§3.4).
24	  * :func:`shard_mode_for_optimizer`  — key the mode off the optimizer (§3.4:
25	                                        elementwise → flat-even; per-tensor →
26	                                        tensor-granular).
27	
28	It does NOT touch ``distributed.py``; a caller (e.g. a future
29	``fused_train_step_distributed``, design §6.2) picks the mode via
30	:func:`shard_mode_for_optimizer` and calls the matching partitioner.
31	"""
32	
33	from __future__ import annotations
34	
35	import dataclasses
36	from typing import Dict, List, Sequence, Tuple
37	
38	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
39	#  Optimizer → shard-mode taxonomy (design §0.4 / §2.4 / §3.4).
40	#
41	#  ELEMENTWISE: shard the flat [0,total) — every per-element update is local, so
42	#  splitting a tensor across ranks is fine. (grokadamw/looksam/prodigy are
43	#  elementwise at APPLY; their global scalar is handled by a tiny all-reduce, NOT
44	#  by the shard partition — so they shard elementwise here.)
45	#
46	#  PER-TENSOR: a whole matrix/tensor must live on one rank (the P2.x stage reads
47	#  the whole tensor cooperatively). muon is per-MATRIX (NS over each 2D weight);
48	#  SG11/SG15/SG2 are per-TENSOR (meta-net over each tensor's elements).
49	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
50	ELEMENTWISE_OPTIMIZERS = frozenset({
51	    "adamw", "lion", "grokfast", "grokadamw", "looksam", "prodigy", "neuralgrok",
52	})
53	PER_TENSOR_OPTIMIZERS = frozenset({
54	    "muon", "supergrok11", "supergrok15", "supergrok2",
55	})
56	
57	# OptId integers (mirror csrc/fused/sm_90/opt_components.cuh::OptId) so a caller
58	# holding the numeric id can map to a mode too. Single source of the spelling.
59	_OPTID_TO_NAME: Dict[int, str] = {
60	    0: "adamw", 1: "lion", 2: "grokfast", 3: "grokadamw", 4: "looksam",
61	    5: "prodigy", 6: "neuralgrok", 7: "muon", 8: "supergrok11",
62	    9: "supergrok15", 10: "supergrok2",
63	}
64	
65	_MODE_ELEMENTWISE = "elementwise_even"
66	_MODE_TENSOR_GRANULAR = "tensor_granular"
67	
68	
69	def shard_mode_for_optimizer(opt) -> str:
70	    """Return the shard mode an optimizer requires (design §3.4).
71	
72	    ``opt`` may be the optimizer NAME (str, case-insensitive) or its OptId int
73	    (0..10). Per-tensor cells (muon/SG11/SG15/SG2) → ``"tensor_granular"``;
74	    everything else → ``"elementwise_even"``.
75	
76	    Raises ``ValueError`` for an unknown optimizer (loud, no silent default —
77	    same discipline as the kernel dispatch, design §1.3).
78	    """
79	    if isinstance(opt, int):
80	        if opt not in _OPTID_TO_NAME:
81	            raise ValueError(f"unknown OptId {opt!r} (expected 0..10)")
82	        name = _OPTID_TO_NAME[opt]
83	    else:
84	        name = str(opt).strip().lower()
85	    if name in PER_TENSOR_OPTIMIZERS:
86	        return _MODE_TENSOR_GRANULAR
87	    if name in ELEMENTWISE_OPTIMIZERS:
88	        return _MODE_ELEMENTWISE
89	    raise ValueError(
90	        f"unknown optimizer {opt!r} — not in the 11-optimizer taxonomy "
91	        f"(elementwise={sorted(ELEMENTWISE_OPTIMIZERS)}, "
92	        f"per_tensor={sorted(PER_TENSOR_OPTIMIZERS)})"
93	    )
94	
95	
96	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
97	#  Result types.
98	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
99	
100	
101	@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
102	class TensorPlacement:
103	    """One tensor's whole-tensor placement under tensor-granular sharding.
104	
105	    ``name``/``numel`` identify the tensor; ``rank`` is the DP rank that owns it
106	    in full (no split). Tensor-granular sharding emits one of these per tensor.
107	    """
108	
109	    name: str
110	    numel: int
111	    rank: int
112	
113	
114	@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
115	class ShardPlan:
116	    """A partition result: each rank's owned (name, start, end) flat slices.
117	
118	    ``slices[r]`` is the list of ``(name, start, end)`` slices rank ``r`` owns
119	    (``end`` exclusive, in the tensor's OWN flat index space). For tensor-granular
120	    mode every slice is a whole tensor ``(name, 0, numel)``; for elementwise mode
121	    a tensor may appear on several ranks as contiguous sub-slices.
122	
123	    ``mode`` is ``"elementwise_even"`` or ``"tensor_granular"``. ``rank_numel[r]``
124	    is the total element count rank ``r`` owns (the balance metric).
125	    """
126	
127	    mode: str
128	    world: int
129	    slices: List[List[Tuple[str, int, int]]]
130	    rank_numel: List[int]
131	
132	    @property
133	    def total_numel(self) -> int:
134	        return sum(self.rank_numel)
135	
136	    def imbalance(self) -> float:
137	        """max/mean rank load (1.0 == perfectly balanced; higher == lumpier).
138	
139	        Tensor-granular is necessarily lumpier than elementwise (whole tensors
140	        can't be split), so this is the "honest cost, measure it" number design
141	        §3.4 calls for. Returns 1.0 for the degenerate world<=1.
142	        """
143	        if self.world <= 1 or self.total_numel == 0:
144	            return 1.0
145	        mean = self.total_numel / self.world
146	        return max(self.rank_numel) / mean if mean > 0 else 1.0
147	
148	
149	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
150	#  Elementwise flat partition (design §2.4).
151	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
152	
153	
154	def even_partition(numel: int, world: int, rank: int) -> Tuple[int, int]:
155	    """Contiguous, padded-even partition of ``numel`` across ``world`` ranks.
156	
157	    Byte-for-byte the convention of ``distributed._even_partition`` (the
158	    DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 flat-partition): each rank owns ``ceil(numel/world)``
159	    elements (last rank clamped), so the union covers ``[0, numel)`` exactly with
160	    no overlap. Mirrored here (not imported) so this pure-Python module needs no
161	    torch import; a unit test asserts it agrees with ``distributed`` when torch
162	    is present.
163	    """
164	    if world <= 1:
165	        return 0, numel
166	    per = (numel + world - 1) // world
167	    start = min(rank * per, numel)
168	    end = min(start + per, numel)
169	    return start, end
170	
171	
172	def partition_elementwise_even(
173	    named_sizes: Sequence[Tuple[str, int]], world: int
174	) -> ShardPlan:
175	    """ELEMENTWISE shard: split each tensor's flat buffer evenly across ranks.
176	
177	    The finer partition (design §2.4) — best balance, valid for the elementwise
178	    optimizers (adamw/lion/grokfast/neuralgrok + the elementwise core of
179	    grokadamw/looksam/prodigy). A tensor MAY be split across ranks (that's fine:
180	    every per-element apply is local).
181	
182	    ``named_sizes`` is ``[(name, numel), ...]`` (e.g. from ``named_parameters()``
183	    sizes). Returns a :class:`ShardPlan` in ``"elementwise_even"`` mode.
184	    """
185	    world = max(1, int(world))
186	    slices: List[List[Tuple[str, int, int]]] = [[] for _ in range(world)]
187	    rank_numel = [0] * world
188	    for name, numel in named_sizes:
189	        numel = int(numel)
190	        if numel < 0:
191	            raise ValueError(f"tensor {name!r} has negative numel {numel}")
192	        for r in range(world):
193	            s, e = even_partition(numel, world, r)
194	            if e > s:
195	                slices[r].append((name, s, e))
196	                rank_numel[r] += e - s
197	    return ShardPlan(_MODE_ELEMENTWISE, world, slices, rank_numel)
198	
199	
200	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
201	#  Tensor-granular partition (design §3.4) — the new requirement.
202	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
203	
204	
205	def partition_tensor_granular(
206	    named_sizes: Sequence[Tuple[str, int]], world: int
207	) -> ShardPlan:
208	    """Assign WHOLE tensors to ranks (greedy by numel, balanced) — design §3.4.
209	
210	    No tensor is split across ranks, which is REQUIRED for the per-tensor
211	    optimizers (muon/SuperGrok11/SuperGrok15/SuperGrok2): their P2.x stages need
212	    the whole matrix/tensor on one rank (design §0.4/§2.4), and the co-located
213	    optimizer state (m/mu/sharpness/slow/gru_state) rides with its tensor.
214	
215	    ALGORITHM — greedy longest-processing-time (LPT): sort tensors descending by
216	    numel, then assign each to the currently least-loaded rank. This is the
217	    standard balanced whole-item bin-packing heuristic; it is deterministic
218	    (a pure function of the size list + world — design §2.7 requires deterministic
219	    shard boundaries) and gives a good (not optimal) balance. Ties broken by the
220	    lowest rank index, then by tensor name, so the result is stable across runs.
221	
222	    Balance is necessarily lumpier than elementwise (the embedding + ff matrices
223	    dominate), so :meth:`ShardPlan.imbalance` is the honest DP-efficiency cost
224	    design §3.4 says to measure.
225	
226	    ``named_sizes`` is ``[(name, numel), ...]``. Returns a :class:`ShardPlan` in
227	    ``"tensor_granular"`` mode where every owned slice is a whole tensor
228	    ``(name, 0, numel)``.
229	    """
230	    world = max(1, int(world))
231	    slices: List[List[Tuple[str, int, int]]] = [[] for _ in range(world)]
232	    rank_numel = [0] * world
233	
234	    # Validate + materialize.
235	    tensors: List[Tuple[str, int]] = []
236	    for name, numel in named_sizes:
237	        numel = int(numel)
238	        if numel < 0:
239	            raise ValueError(f"tensor {name!r} has negative numel {numel}")
240	        tensors.append((name, numel))
241	
242	    # LPT: descending by numel; tie-break by name so the order is total + stable.
243	    order = sorted(tensors, key=lambda t: (-t[1], t[0]))
244	    for name, numel in order:
245	        # Least-loaded rank; ties → lowest rank index (min() is stable on the
246	        # (load, rank) key).
247	        r = min(range(world), key=lambda k: (rank_numel[k], k))
248	        slices[r].append((name, 0, numel))
249	        rank_numel[r] += numel
250	
251	    # Keep each rank's slice list in the input (named_parameters()) order, so the
252	    # owned slices are reported in a stable, layout-meaningful order (the kernel
253	    # addresses tensors in named_parameters() order — decoder_layout.cuh).
254	    input_order = {name: i for i, (name, _) in enumerate(tensors)}
255	    for r in range(world):
256	        slices[r].sort(key=lambda sl: input_order[sl[0]])
257	
258	    return ShardPlan(_MODE_TENSOR_GRANULAR, world, slices, rank_numel)
259	
260	
261	def partition_for_optimizer(
262	    named_sizes: Sequence[Tuple[str, int]], world: int, opt
263	) -> ShardPlan:
264	    """Pick the partition mode from the optimizer (design §3.4) and run it.
265	
266	    Convenience wrapper: per-tensor cells → :func:`partition_tensor_granular`;
267	    elementwise cells → :func:`partition_elementwise_even`.
268	    """
269	    mode = shard_mode_for_optimizer(opt)
270	    if mode == _MODE_TENSOR_GRANULAR:
271	        return partition_tensor_granular(named_sizes, world)
272	    return partition_elementwise_even(named_sizes, world)

1	"""grokking_optimizers/parallel/pipeline.py — the PIPELINE-PARALLEL schedule
2	(1F1B), stage partition of the megakernel step, and activation hand-off plan.
3	
4	IMPLEMENTS /workspace/.parallelism_design.md §4 (task #25 phase-2, Lane C):
5	  * §4.1 stage partitioning — contiguous layer ranges + the per-stage TENSOR
6	    ownership of the megakernel's flat layout (the host mirror of the
7	    kernel-side ``PPStageSpec`` in csrc/fused/sm_90/pp_stage_decoder_tc.cuh;
8	    the two are cross-checked by tests/hw/test_pp2_loopback_determinism.py::
9	    test_pp2_stage_ownership_matches_python_plan).
10	  * §4.1 hand-off buffers — the fwd boundary payload is the acts X_in[L]
11	    region (bf16 [T,d], already in HBM by the acts-to-HBM design) and the bwd
12	    payload is the fp32 [T,d] boundary adjoint (fp32 ON PURPOSE: it is the
13	    bit-preserving carrier — see the layer-range patch).
14	  * §4.2 the 1F1B microbatch schedule (standard Megatron non-interleaved
15	    1F1B: warmup fwds, steady 1F1B, cooldown bwds) + a dependency-simulating
16	    validator + the generic host-side driver ``run_1f1b``.
17	
18	PURE PYTHON, no torch required (design §7: CPU-validatable now). The driver
19	takes callables; the GPU test binds them to the real stage-kernel launches,
20	the CPU test binds recording stubs. The transport is a swap point:
21	``LoopbackP2P`` (in-process, single device — used by the 1-GPU tests) vs the
22	real ``torch.distributed`` P2P on the pp_group (8×H100 window; the existing
23	``DistributedContext.pp_group`` from distributed.py is the comm fabric).
24	
25	HONEST SCOPE (design §4.3): PP is pure overhead at the 2-layer race depth —
26	these pieces exist because the FLAGSHIP ships full 4D (owner-locked) and the
27	machinery must be validated before the rental window. The loopback gate proves
28	stage-composition CORRECTNESS (bit-exactness); PP's throughput contribution is
29	an 8×-window measurement, never assumed.
30	"""
31	
32	from __future__ import annotations
33	
34	import dataclasses
35	from typing import Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple
36	
37	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
38	#  Stage partition (§4.1).
39	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
40	
41	
42	def stage_layer_ranges(n_layers: int, num_stages: int) -> List[Tuple[int, int]]:
43	    """Contiguous even layer split: stage s owns layers [s*L/P, (s+1)*L/P).
44	
45	    Mirrors ``PPStageSpec``'s static_asserts: requires ``num_stages | n_layers``
46	    (loud ValueError otherwise — no silent uneven split; an uneven split is a
47	    DIFFERENT design decision that must be taken explicitly).
48	    """
49	    if num_stages < 1 or n_layers < 1:
50	        raise ValueError(f"need n_layers>=1, num_stages>=1; got {n_layers}, {num_stages}")
51	    if num_stages > n_layers:
52	        raise ValueError(f"num_stages={num_stages} > n_layers={n_layers}")
53	    if n_layers % num_stages != 0:
54	        raise ValueError(
55	            f"contiguous even split requires num_stages | n_layers "
56	            f"({num_stages} ∤ {n_layers}) — mirror of PPStageSpec's static_assert")
57	    per = n_layers // num_stages
58	    return [(s * per, (s + 1) * per) for s in range(num_stages)]
59	
60	
61	# Declarative flat-layout structure per model (named_parameters() order — the
62	# SINGLE structural fact the ownership map needs; counts mirror the generated
63	# layout headers, e.g. decoder_layout.cuh's 30 = 2 + 2*12 + 4). No numeric
64	# offsets here: offsets/sizes stay owned by the generated layout headers.
65	_MODEL_LAYOUT_STRUCTURE: Dict[str, Dict[str, object]] = {
66	    "decoder": {
67	        "n_layers": 2,
68	        "prefix": 2,        # tok.weight, pos.weight        → FIRST stage
69	        "per_layer": 12,    # in_w,in_b,out_w,out_b,n1w,n1b,n2w,n2b,ff0w,ff0b,ff2w,ff2b
70	        "suffix": 4,        # norm.w, norm.b, out.weight, out.bias → LAST stage
71	    },
72	}
73	
74	
75	def stage_tensor_ownership(model: str, num_stages: int) -> List[List[int]]:
76	    """Per-stage owned flat-tensor indices (named_parameters() order) — §4.1.
77	
78	    Stage owning layers [Llo,Lhi) owns the per-layer tensor block
79	    [prefix + per_layer*Llo, prefix + per_layer*Lhi); the FIRST stage adds the
80	    prefix (embeddings); the LAST adds the suffix (final norm + head). This is
81	    the host mirror of ``PPStageSpec::owns_tensor`` — kept structurally
82	    identical and pinned by the kernel-side cross-check test.
83	    """
84	    if model not in _MODEL_LAYOUT_STRUCTURE:
85	        raise ValueError(
86	            f"unknown model {model!r} for PP ownership "
87	            f"(have {sorted(_MODEL_LAYOUT_STRUCTURE)}); add its layout structure "
88	            f"— do NOT default silently")
89	    st = _MODEL_LAYOUT_STRUCTURE[model]
90	    n_layers = int(st["n_layers"])
91	    prefix = int(st["prefix"])
92	    per_layer = int(st["per_layer"])
93	    suffix = int(st["suffix"])
94	    ranges = stage_layer_ranges(n_layers, num_stages)
95	    total = prefix + per_layer * n_layers + suffix
96	    out: List[List[int]] = []
97	    for s, (llo, lhi) in enumerate(ranges):
98	        own = list(range(prefix + per_layer * llo, prefix + per_layer * lhi))
99	        if s == 0:
100	            own = list(range(prefix)) + own
101	        if s == num_stages - 1:
102	            own += list(range(total - suffix, total))
103	        out.append(sorted(own))
104	    # Invariant: disjoint + complete (loud — a partition bug corrupts grads).
105	    flat = [t for o in out for t in o]
106	    if sorted(flat) != list(range(total)):
107	        raise AssertionError(f"ownership not a partition of [0,{total}): {out}")
108	    return out
109	
110	
111	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
112	#  Hand-off buffer plan (§4.1).
113	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
114	
115	
116	@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
117	class HandoffSpec:
118	    """One stage boundary's per-microbatch payloads.
119	
120	    fwd: the boundary activation X_in[L] — bf16 [T_mb, d] (T_mb = mb rows × seq).
121	    bwd: the boundary adjoint dh — fp32 [T_mb, d] (the bit-preserving carrier).
122	    """
123	
124	    boundary_layer: int       # the L of X_in[L] (== upstream stage's Lhi)
125	    fwd_numel: int            # T_mb * d  (bf16 elements)
126	    fwd_bytes: int
127	    bwd_numel: int            # T_mb * d  (fp32 elements)
128	    bwd_bytes: int
129	
130	
131	def handoff_plan(d_model: int, seq: int, microbatch_rows: int,
132	                 n_layers: int, num_stages: int) -> List[HandoffSpec]:
133	    """The §4.1 hand-off plan: one spec per stage boundary (num_stages-1)."""
134	    ranges = stage_layer_ranges(n_layers, num_stages)
135	    t_mb = microbatch_rows * seq
136	    out = []
137	    for s in range(num_stages - 1):
138	        boundary = ranges[s][1]
139	        n = t_mb * d_model
140	        out.append(HandoffSpec(boundary_layer=boundary,
141	                               fwd_numel=n, fwd_bytes=2 * n,    # bf16
142	                               bwd_numel=n, bwd_bytes=4 * n))   # fp32
143	    return out
144	
145	
146	def max_inflight_microbatches(num_stages: int, num_microbatches: int,
147	                              stage: int) -> int:
148	    """1F1B liveness bound: stage s holds ≤ min(P - s, M) microbatches' fwd
149	    state (handoff inputs) live at once — the per-stage buffer count."""
150	    return min(num_stages - stage, num_microbatches)
151	
152	
153	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
154	#  1F1B schedule (§4.2) — standard Megatron non-interleaved.
155	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
156	
157	Op = Tuple[str, int]          # ("fwd"|"bwd", microbatch_index)
158	
159	
160	def build_1f1b_schedule(num_stages: int, num_microbatches: int) -> List[List[Op]]:
161	    """Per-stage op order for non-interleaved 1F1B.
162	
163	    Stage s: warmup = min(P-1-s, M) fwds; steady: (M - warmup) × (fwd, bwd)
164	    pairs; cooldown: the remaining warmup bwds. M >= 1; P >= 1. Total per
165	    stage: M fwds + M bwds, each microbatch exactly once.
166	    """
167	    if num_stages < 1 or num_microbatches < 1:
168	        raise ValueError("num_stages and num_microbatches must be >= 1")
169	    P, M = num_stages, num_microbatches
170	    sched: List[List[Op]] = []
171	    for s in range(P):
172	        ops: List[Op] = []
173	        warmup = min(P - 1 - s, M)
174	        steady = M - warmup
175	        f = 0  # next fwd mb
176	        b = 0  # next bwd mb
177	        for _ in range(warmup):
178	            ops.append(("fwd", f))
179	            f += 1
180	        for _ in range(steady):
181	            ops.append(("fwd", f))
182	            f += 1
183	            ops.append(("bwd", b))
184	            b += 1
185	        while b < M:
186	            ops.append(("bwd", b))
187	            b += 1
188	        sched.append(ops)
189	    return sched
190	
191	
192	def bubble_fraction(num_stages: int, num_microbatches: int) -> float:
193	    """The textbook 1F1B bubble: (P-1)/(M+P-1) — §4.3's honest cost number."""
194	    P, M = num_stages, num_microbatches
195	    return (P - 1) / (M + P - 1)
196	
197	
198	def validate_1f1b_schedule(sched: List[List[Op]], num_microbatches: int) -> None:
199	    """Simulate the cross-stage dependency graph; raise on any violation.
200	
201	    Dependencies (the §4.1 dataflow):
202	      fwd(s, mb) needs fwd(s-1, mb)   (the fwd activation handoff)
203	      bwd(s, mb) needs fwd(s, mb) and bwd(s+1, mb)  (the dh handoff)
204	    The greedy event-loop simulation must drain every stage's queue — a stall
205	    with no runnable head op is a deadlock ⇒ schedule bug. Also asserts each
206	    stage runs every microbatch exactly once per direction and respects the
207	    1F1B liveness bound (max_inflight_microbatches).
208	    """
209	    P = len(sched)
210	    M = num_microbatches
211	    for s, ops in enumerate(sched):
212	        fwds = [mb for kind, mb in ops if kind == "fwd"]
213	        bwds = [mb for kind, mb in ops if kind == "bwd"]
214	        if sorted(fwds) != list(range(M)) or sorted(bwds) != list(range(M)):
215	            raise AssertionError(f"stage {s}: each mb must fwd+bwd exactly once: {ops}")
216	    done_f = [[False] * M for _ in range(P)]
217	    done_b = [[False] * M for _ in range(P)]
218	    heads = [0] * P
219	    inflight_peak = [0] * P
220	    inflight = [0] * P
221	    progressed = True
222	    while progressed:
223	        progressed = False
224	        for s in range(P):
225	            while heads[s] < len(sched[s]):
226	                kind, mb = sched[s][heads[s]]
227	                if kind == "fwd":
228	                    ready = (s == 0) or done_f[s - 1][mb]
229	                    if not ready:
230	                        break
231	                    done_f[s][mb] = True
232	                    inflight[s] += 1
233	                    inflight_peak[s] = max(inflight_peak[s], inflight[s])
234	                else:
235	                    ready = done_f[s][mb] and ((s == P - 1) or done_b[s + 1][mb])
236	                    if not ready:
237	                        break
238	                    done_b[s][mb] = True
239	                    inflight[s] -= 1
240	                heads[s] += 1
241	                progressed = True
242	    stalled = [s for s in range(P) if heads[s] < len(sched[s])]
243	    if stalled:
244	        raise AssertionError(
245	            f"1F1B schedule DEADLOCKED at stages {stalled} "
246	            f"(heads={heads}, lens={[len(x) for x in sched]})")
247	    for s in range(P):
248	        bound = max_inflight_microbatches(P, M, s)
249	        if inflight_peak[s] > bound:
250	            raise AssertionError(
251	                f"stage {s}: in-flight peak {inflight_peak[s]} exceeds the 1F1B "
252	                f"bound {bound} — the memory guarantee is broken")
253	
254	
255	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
256	#  Transport swap point + the generic host-side driver (§4.2).
257	# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
258	
259	
260	class LoopbackP2P:
261	    """In-process P2P for the single-GPU loopback: send/recv keyed by
262	    (src_stage, dst_stage, microbatch, tag). HONEST semantics: recv of a
263	    never-sent key raises (a real recv would block forever — we surface the
264	    schedule bug loudly instead); each payload is consumed exactly once.
265	
266	    The 8×H100 swap-in is ``torch.distributed`` isend/irecv on the pp_group
267	    (``DistributedContext.pp_group``); the driver below only touches this
268	    send/recv surface, so the swap changes no driver logic.
269	    """
270	
271	    def __init__(self) -> None:
272	        self._box: Dict[Tuple[int, int, int, str], object] = {}
273	        self.sends = 0
274	        self.recvs = 0
275	
276	    def send(self, src: int, dst: int, mb: int, tag: str, payload: object) -> None:
277	        key = (src, dst, mb, tag)
278	        if key in self._box:
279	            raise AssertionError(f"double-send {key} (unconsumed payload)")
280	        self._box[key] = payload
281	        self.sends += 1
282	
283	    def recv(self, src: int, dst: int, mb: int, tag: str) -> object:
284	        key = (src, dst, mb, tag)
285	        if key not in self._box:
286	            raise AssertionError(
287	                f"recv-before-send {key} — schedule dependency violation "
288	                f"(a real P2P recv would deadlock here)")
289	        self.recvs += 1
290	        return self._box.pop(key)
291	
292	    def drained(self) -> bool:
293	        return not self._box
294	
295	
296	def run_1f1b(num_stages: int, num_microbatches: int,
297	             fwd_fn: Callable[[int, int, Optional[object]], object],
298	             bwd_fn: Callable[[int, int, Optional[object]], Optional[object]],
299	             transport: Optional[LoopbackP2P] = None,
300	             schedule: Optional[List[List[Op]]] = None) -> LoopbackP2P:
301	    """Execute a (validated) 1F1B schedule against stage callables.
302	
303	    fwd_fn(stage, mb, fwd_in)  -> fwd_out  (the boundary activation payload;
304	        fwd_in is None for stage 0, else the upstream handoff). For the LAST
305	        stage the return value is ignored (no downstream).
306	    bwd_fn(stage, mb, dh_in)   -> dh_out   (the fp32 boundary adjoint; dh_in is
307	        None for the LAST stage — it starts from CE; return None for stage 0).
308	
309	    Single-process driver: executes ops in a dependency-respecting global
310	    order (the same event loop the validator uses), calling each stage's ops
311	    in ITS schedule order — semantically what P concurrent rank processes do,
312	    minus the parallelism (the 1-GPU loopback shape; the 8× driver runs one
313	    rank's lane per process with real P2P). Returns the transport (for
314	    drain/count asserts).
315	    """
316	    P, M = num_stages, num_microbatches
317	    sched = schedule if schedule is not None else build_1f1b_schedule(P, M)
318	    validate_1f1b_schedule(sched, M)
319	    tr = transport if transport is not None else LoopbackP2P()
320	
321	    done_f = [[False] * M for _ in range(P)]
322	    done_b = [[False] * M for _ in range(P)]
323	    heads = [0] * P
324	    progressed = True
325	    while progressed:
326	        progressed = False
327	        for s in range(P):
328	            while heads[s] < len(sched[s]):
329	                kind, mb = sched[s][heads[s]]
330	                if kind == "fwd":
331	                    if not (s == 0 or done_f[s - 1][mb]):
332	                        break
333	                    fwd_in = None if s == 0 else tr.recv(s - 1, s, mb, "act")
334	                    out = fwd_fn(s, mb, fwd_in)
335	                    if s < P - 1:
336	                        tr.send(s, s + 1, mb, "act", out)
337	                    done_f[s][mb] = True
338	                else:
339	                    if not (done_f[s][mb] and (s == P - 1 or done_b[s + 1][mb])):
340	                        break
341	                    dh_in = None if s == P - 1 else tr.recv(s + 1, s, mb, "dh")
342	                    dh_out = bwd_fn(s, mb, dh_in)
343	                    if s > 0:
344	                        tr.send(s, s - 1, mb, "dh", dh_out)
345	                    done_b[s][mb] = True
346	                heads[s] += 1
347	                progressed = True
348	    stalled = [s for s in range(P) if heads[s] < len(sched[s])]
349	    if stalled:
350	        raise AssertionError(f"run_1f1b deadlocked at stages {stalled}")
351	    if not tr.drained():
352	        raise AssertionError(f"undrained handoffs: {list(tr._box)}")
353	    return tr
354	
355	
356	__all__ = [
357	    "stage_layer_ranges",
358	    "stage_tensor_ownership",
359	    "HandoffSpec",
360	    "handoff_plan",
361	    "max_inflight_microbatches",
362	    "build_1f1b_schedule",
363	    "bubble_fraction",
364	    "validate_1f1b_schedule",
365	    "LoopbackP2P",
366	    "run_1f1b",
367	]

1	#ifndef SG_FUSED_SM90_PARALLEL_CONFIG_CUH_
2	#define SG_FUSED_SM90_PARALLEL_CONFIG_CUH_
3	// ============================================================================
4	// csrc/fused/sm_90/parallel_config.cuh — the COMPILE-TIME parallelism point
5	// (the metaprogrammed template the L3-TC megakernel is specialized over).
6	//
7	// IMPLEMENTS: /workspace/.parallelism_design.md §1.1 (the ParConfig<DP,TP,PP,
8	// SP,ZeROStage> struct + the SingleGPU alias) and §1.2 (the bit-identical
9	// single-GPU contract — the kEmitComm gate that makes every comm branch fold
10	// away to ZERO code when the config is degenerate).
11	//
12	// HEADER-ONLY, SELF-CONTAINED, device+host. Included by every megakernel TU
13	// (decoder/vit/mamba) so the SAME translation unit can hold BOTH the single-GPU
14	// point AND a multi-GPU flagship point in one fat binary (design §1.2 — the
15	// discriminator is a TEMPLATE PARAMETER, not a TU-wide macro, because the
16	// campaign ships the single-GPU artifact alongside the 4D+ZeRO-3 flagship).
17	//
18	// WHY constexpr-everything: ALL fields are `static constexpr`, so every branch
19	// that reads them (`if constexpr (Par::kEmitComm)`, `if constexpr (Par::
20	// kShardOptGrad)`, …) folds at compile time. For the degenerate SingleGPU point
21	// the compiler emits NO NVSHMEM symbols, NO extra barriers, NO `comm` reads ⇒
22	// `fused_decoder_megakernel_tc<Opt, SingleGPU>` is byte-for-byte identical to
23	// today's `fused_decoder_megakernel_tc<Opt>` (design §1.2, the PTX-diff gate).
24	//
25	// THIS FILE ADDS NO MATH AND NO COMM. It is the pure compile-time config carrier
26	// + an empty CommCtx POD (the megakernel's default `comm` argument; populated
27	// with NCCL/NVSHMEM handles ONLY on the kEmitComm path, which a kernel builder
28	// wires later — out of scope here). Authored 1-GPU/CPU per design §7.
29	// ============================================================================
30	
31	#include <cstdint>
32	
33	namespace sg { namespace fused { namespace par {
34	
35	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
36	//  ZeRO stage (design §1.1). Z0=none, Z1=opt-state shard, Z2=+grad shard,
37	//  Z3=+param shard. The flagship ships Z3 (design DELIVERABLE line); Z2 is the
38	//  SAME code path with param-sharding off (a stage flag), the first bring-up
39	//  increment (design §3.1).
40	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
41	enum class ZeROStage : int { Z0 = 0, Z1 = 1, Z2 = 2, Z3 = 3 };
42	
43	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
44	//  ParConfig — the compile-time 4D(+ZeRO) parallelism point (design §1.1).
45	//
46	//  The (DP, TP, PP, SP, ZeRO) tuple maps 1:1 to the Python-side ParallelConfig
47	//  (distributed.py) per design §1.3. ALL fields constexpr ⇒ every consumer
48	//  branch folds; the degenerate point emits zero comm code (design §1.2).
49	//
50	//  SP (sequence-parallel) is EXPRESSIBLE but pinned to 1 this campaign: at the
51	//  race's seq 4-17 a sequence split is moot (design §1.1 / PARALLELISM-FINAL),
52	//  so the static_assert below makes any SP!=1 instantiation a loud BUILD error
53	//  rather than a silently-broken path.
54	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
55	template <int DP, int TP, int PP, int SP, ZeROStage Z>
56	struct ParConfig {
57	    static constexpr int        kDP   = DP;   // data-parallel replicas
58	    static constexpr int        kTP   = TP;   // tensor-parallel ranks (Megatron col/row split)
59	    static constexpr int        kPP   = PP;   // pipeline stages
60	    static constexpr int        kSP   = SP;   // sequence-parallel (kept EXPRESSIBLE, fixed 1)
61	    static constexpr ZeROStage  kZeRO = Z;
62	
63	    // ── Derived compile-time gates (design §1.1). These are the predicates the
64	    //    megakernel + sharded-opt kernel branch on with `if constexpr`. ────────
65	    static constexpr bool kIsSingleGPU = (DP == 1 && TP == 1 && PP == 1 && SP == 1);
66	    static constexpr bool kEmitComm     = !kIsSingleGPU;        // gate ALL NVSHMEM/NCCL
67	    static constexpr bool kShardParams  = (Z == ZeROStage::Z3);  // ZeRO-3 param residency shard
68	    static constexpr bool kShardOptGrad = (Z >= ZeROStage::Z2);  // ZeRO>=2 grad+opt-state shard
69	                                                                 // ⇒ kernel early-exits at B2 (§2.2)
70	    static constexpr bool kTPComm       = (TP > 1);             // in-kernel TP all-reduce (§5)
71	    static constexpr bool kPPStage      = (PP > 1);             // pipeline stage cut (§4)
72	
73	    // SP is expressible but must be 1 this campaign (design §1.1 static_assert).
74	    static_assert(SP == 1, "SP axis is expressible but must be 1 this campaign "
75	                           "(seq 4-17 makes a seq split moot; #14 / PARALLELISM-FINAL).");
76	    static_assert(DP >= 1 && TP >= 1 && PP >= 1 && SP >= 1, "degrees must be >= 1");
77	};
78	
79	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
80	//  THE single-GPU guarantee, named once so the static_asserts read cleanly
81	//  (design §1.1). `fused_decoder_megakernel_tc<Opt, SingleGPU>` MUST be
82	//  byte-identical to the legacy `<Opt>` overload — enforced by kEmitComm==false
83	//  folding every comm branch away (design §1.2). This is the default template
84	//  arg of the megakernel, so existing call sites compile unchanged.
85	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
86	using SingleGPU = ParConfig<1, 1, 1, 1, ZeROStage::Z0>;
87	
88	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
89	//  CommCtx — the megakernel's default trailing argument (design §1.1 kernel
90	//  signature: `par::CommCtx comm /* default-constructed, unused when
91	//  !kEmitComm */`). It is an EMPTY POD here on purpose:
92	//
93	//   * On the SingleGPU / kEmitComm==false path the kernel never reads it, so the
94	//     ABI of the `<Opt>`-only overload is preserved (the old non-Par launcher
95	//     forwards a default-constructed CommCtx) and the PTX is unchanged.
96	//   * On the kEmitComm==true path a kernel builder widens this POD with the
97	//     NVSHMEM team handle / NCCL comm / tp_group rank table / peer param-shard
98	//     base pointers the in-kernel collectives need (design §5.2/§6.1). That
99	//     widening is GPU-window work and is intentionally NOT authored here (this
100	//     file is 1-GPU/CPU pre-work per design §7); the empty struct is the stable
101	//     seam those fields hang off without touching any single-GPU call site.
102	//
103	//  Trivially constructible/copyable so it is a valid by-value kernel parameter
104	//  and a no-cost default argument.
105	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
106	struct CommCtx {
107	    // rank within the world / the per-axis groups (filled only when kEmitComm).
108	    // Defaults describe the degenerate single-GPU world so a default-constructed
109	    // CommCtx is the correct "no comm" value the single-GPU path forwards.
110	    int world_size = 1;
111	    int world_rank = 0;
112	    int dp_size = 1, dp_rank = 0;
113	    int tp_size = 1, tp_rank = 0;
114	    int pp_size = 1, pp_rank = 0;
115	    // Opaque handle slots (NVSHMEM team / NCCL comm) — left as nullptr-able
116	    // pointers a builder casts to the concrete handle type behind kEmitComm, so
117	    // this header need NOT include <nccl.h>/<nvshmem.h> (kept CPU-compilable).
118	    void* tp_comm_handle = nullptr;   // NCCL comm / NVSHMEM team for the TP group (§5)
119	    void* dp_comm_handle = nullptr;   // NCCL comm for the DP group (reduce-scatter / all-gather)
120	};
121	
122	}}}  // namespace sg::fused::par
123	
124	#endif  // SG_FUSED_SM90_PARALLEL_CONFIG_CUH_

2	#define SG_FUSED_SM90_SHARDED_OPTIMIZER_KERNEL_CUH_
3	// ============================================================================
4	// csrc/fused/sm_90/sharded_optimizer_kernel.cuh — the POST-reduce-scatter
5	// sharded optimizer kernel for the ZeRO-2/3 multi-GPU step.
6	//
7	// IMPLEMENTS: /workspace/.parallelism_design.md §2.3 (the new, small sharded-
8	// optimizer kernel) — the second half of the owner's B2-seam decomposition
9	// (design §0.1/§2.1):
10	//     [fwd+bwd megakernel] → reduce-scatter(grad) → [THIS kernel] → all-gather(params)
11	//
12	// WHAT IT IS: under ZeRO>=2 the fused megakernel early-exits right after the B2
13	// barrier (design §2.2, `if constexpr (Par::kShardOptGrad) return;`) with the
14	// reduced LOCAL grad assembled. The host then reduce-scatters that grad so each
15	// rank holds the reduced grad for ONLY its owned shard. THIS kernel applies the
16	// optimizer over that owned shard. For the ELEMENTWISE optimizers it is exactly
17	// P3 (the fused tail) with the work-steal-over-30-tensors loop replaced by a
18	// flat grid-stride over [0, shard_numel) and NO GridBarrier (single phase).
19	//
20	// ZERO NEW MATH (design §2.3, the parity guarantee): every per-element update is
21	// the EXACT SAME `apply_optimizer<Opt>` from opt_components.cuh — the canonical
22	// `csrc/algorithms/<opt>.h` device math the in-kernel P3 tail already calls and
23	// the parity gates already validate. This file INCLUDES opt_components.cuh and
24	// reuses it verbatim; it does NOT edit it and adds no new optimizer math, so the
25	// sharded path inherits the single-GPU A/A/A correctness per element (design
26	// §7.3: the DP=1 sharded kernel must be bit-identical to the in-kernel P3).
27	//
28	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
29	//  THE PER-TENSOR BOUNDARY (design §2.3 / §3.4 / §0.4) — read before using this
30	//  for muon / SuperGrok11 / SuperGrok15 / SuperGrok2:
31	//
32	//  `apply_optimizer<Opt>` is, for ALL 11 OptIds, a PURELY ELEMENTWISE update of
33	//  one `idx`: it consumes ONLY per-element state (exp_avg/exp_avg_sq/ema/...) and
34	//  PRE-COMPUTED inputs carried in FusedOptState (st.orth, st.mu, st.gate,
35	//  st.smart_grad, st.sam_dir, st.d_factor, st.clip_coef, ...). So this flat
36	//  grid-stride kernel COMPILES and RUNS correctly for any OptId *whose
37	//  FusedOptState inputs are already filled* — i.e. it is a complete, correct
38	//  optimizer step for:
39	//
40	//    ELEMENTWISE-DRIVABLE (this kernel alone is sufficient at DP):
41	//      adamw(0), lion(1), grokfast(2), neuralgrok(6),
42	//      and the ELEMENTWISE CORE of grokadamw(3)/looksam(4)/prodigy(5)
43	//      *given* their global/precomputed scalar already in st (clip_coef /
44	//      sam_dir / d_factor — see the next paragraph for where those come from).
45	//
46	//    PER-TENSOR / PER-MATRIX (this kernel is the APPLY ONLY — its st inputs need
47	//    an UPSTREAM stage that is OUT OF SCOPE for this kernel):
48	//      muon(7)        → st.orth     : Newton–Schulz over a WHOLE 2D weight (P2.7)
49	//      supergrok11(8) → st.mu/gate  : per-TENSOR meta-net mu/gate (P2.45)
50	//      supergrok15(9) → st.mu/gate  : per-TENSOR meta-net mu     (P2.45)
51	//      supergrok2(10) → st.smart_grad: per-TENSOR CSA/HCA/PEER/GRU + segmented
52	//                                      sort meta-net (STAGE -1 + P3-SG2)
53	//    Those P2.x stages cooperate across CTAs PER matrix/tensor on the GridBarrier
54	//    substrate, so they REQUIRE the tensor whole on one rank — which forces the
55	//    ZeRO-3 shard to be TENSOR-GRANULAR for these cells (design §3.4;
56	//    grokking_optimizers/parallel/shard_map.py::partition_tensor_granular). The
57	//    sharded-optimizer kernel FOR THEM is the *full* persistent megakernel
58	//    restricted to the tensors this rank owns (design §2.3) — NOT this flat
59	//    kernel. This flat kernel deliberately does NOT run those P2.x stages; it
60	//    only does the elementwise apply once their st inputs exist.
61	//
62	//  Likewise the GLOBAL-scalar cells (prodigy d, grokadamw grad-norm clip_coef,
63	//  looksam ‖g‖) need a cross-DP all-reduce of one/two scalars BEFORE this kernel
64	//  (design §2.4) so every rank's `st.d_factor`/`st.clip_coef` agree; that
65	//  all-reduce is host-side orchestration (design §6.2 step 4), also out of scope
66	//  here. This kernel just consumes the agreed scalar from st.
67	//
68	//  Net: every OptId COMPILE-CHECKS here (apply_optimizer is elementwise). Which
69	//  ones are *correct from this kernel alone* vs need the upstream stage/all-
70	//  reduce is the taxonomy above — documented per design §2.3/§3.4, enforced by
71	//  the host shard-mode selection (elementwise → flat-even; per-tensor →
72	//  tensor-granular).
73	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
74	//
75	// CPU/1-GPU AUTHORABLE (design §7.3): this is the cut the test_sharded_optimizer
76	// gate validates entirely on one GPU. Authored here as NEW code; the kernel
77	// builder owns wiring it into dispatch + the explicit instantiations.
78	// ============================================================================
79	
80	#include <cstdint>
81	#include <cuda_runtime.h>
82	
83	// The canonical per-optimizer elementwise math + the FusedOptState ABI. We REUSE
84	// apply_optimizer<Opt> / OptId / FusedOptState verbatim — INCLUDE, do not edit
85	// (design §2.3: zero new math, reuse the validated single-GPU tail).
86	#include "csrc/fused/sm_90/opt_components.cuh"
87	
88	namespace sg { namespace fused { namespace sm90 {
89	
90	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
91	//  sharded_optimizer_kernel<Opt, Par> — flat grid-stride over the OWNED shard.
92	//
93	//  Args (design §2.3 signature):
94	//    params_shard : [shard_numel] this rank's owned param slice (mutated in place)
95	//    grad_shard   : [shard_numel] the reduce-scattered grad for the owned slice
96	//    lr, step     : the step's learning rate + 1-based step counter
97	//    st_shard     : FusedOptState whose pointers are ALREADY rebased to the shard
98	//                   (the host offsets exp_avg/exp_avg_sq/ema/... to the owned
99	//                   slice before launch — the per-element ABI is shard-local, so
100	//                   index `i` into params_shard pairs with index `i` into every
101	//                   st_shard buffer, exactly like the in-kernel P3 owns each
102	//                   element once). st_shard also carries the per-step scalars
103	//                   already folded via apply_scalars (bc1/bc2/d_factor/clip_coef/
104	//                   gate/...), and the precomputed per-tensor pointers (orth/mu/
105	//                   smart_grad/sam_dir) for the per-tensor cells.
106	//
107	//  NO GridBarrier (single phase): the work-steal-over-30-tensors loop of P3 is
108	//  replaced by one flat grid-stride over [0, shard_numel). Each element is
109	//  written exactly once by the thread that owns its `i`, so there is no cross-CTA
110	//  dependence and no barrier (design §2.3). `lr` is threaded into st_shard.lr so
111	//  apply_optimizer reads a single source for the rate (matches the P3 contract).
112	//
113	//  Par is carried for ABI/symmetry with the megakernel template (design §1.1)
114	//  and to let a builder add `if constexpr (Par::kEmitComm)` hooks later (e.g. a
115	//  fused all-gather-on-write for ZeRO-3). It is otherwise unused by the
116	//  elementwise apply — the shard is already local when this kernel runs.
117	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
118	template <OptId Opt, class Par>
119	__global__ void sharded_optimizer_kernel(
120	        float* __restrict__ params_shard,        // [shard_numel] owned param slice
121	        const float* __restrict__ grad_shard,    // [shard_numel] reduce-scattered grad
122	        int64_t shard_numel,
123	        float lr, int step,
124	        FusedOptState st_shard /* pointers pre-rebased to the shard */) {
125	    // Single source for the rate (the P3 tail reads st.lr; mirror that here so a
126	    // caller that passes lr positionally and a caller that pre-folds it via
127	    // apply_scalars agree bit-for-bit).
128	    st_shard.lr = lr;
129	
130	    const int64_t stride = static_cast<int64_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
131	    int64_t i = static_cast<int64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
132	    for (; i < shard_numel; i += stride) {
133	        // EXACT same canonical math as the in-kernel P3 tail (opt_components.cuh).
134	        // Shard-local index i pairs params_shard[i] with grad_shard[i] and every
135	        // pre-rebased st_shard buffer at [i]. Zero new math (design §2.3).
136	        apply_optimizer<Opt>(params_shard, grad_shard, i, step, st_shard);
137	    }
138	}
139	
140	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
141	//  Host launcher — a thin grid-stride launch (design §2.3: "~30 lines, no
142	//  GridBarrier, single phase"). Sized to the shard, NOT the full param set. A
143	//  kernel builder routes this from dispatch behind the ZeRO>=2 path + the
144	//  explicit ParConfig instantiation allow-list (design §1.3/§7.2); it is left
145	//  here as the canonical small launcher so the kernel has a tested entry point.
146	//
147	//  NOTE: no GPU is launched in this CPU/1-GPU pre-work (design §7); this launcher
148	//  is COMPILE-CHECKED only. block=256 mirrors the per-op elementwise launchers'
149	//  default; grid is capped so the grid-stride covers any shard_numel.
150	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
151	template <OptId Opt, class Par>
152	inline cudaError_t launch_sharded_optimizer_kernel(
153	        float* params_shard, const float* grad_shard, int64_t shard_numel,
154	        float lr, int step, const FusedOptState& st_shard,
155	        cudaStream_t stream = nullptr, int block = 256, int max_grid = 65535) {
156	    if (shard_numel <= 0) return cudaSuccess;
157	    int64_t want = (shard_numel + block - 1) / block;
158	    int grid = static_cast<int>(want < max_grid ? want : max_grid);
159	    if (grid < 1) grid = 1;
160	    sharded_optimizer_kernel<Opt, Par><<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
161	        params_shard, grad_shard, shard_numel, lr, step, st_shard);
162	    return cudaGetLastError();
163	}
164	
165	}}} // namespace sg::fused::sm90
166	
167	#endif  // SG_FUSED_SM90_SHARDED_OPTIMIZER_KERNEL_CUH_
